AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mechanized infantry
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is a form of mechanized infantry, very powerful war units that are unfortunately very weakly programmed.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Factory made
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: this mech was formed inside an ancient factory.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mechanized infantry
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} are a form of prototype mechanized infantry, very powerful war units which allow for their stored digitized minds a secure host and allows them to participate on the battlefields.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Prototype M8
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: this mech is prototype created from an M7 to which we graft limited SkyCore and Skyminds modules.
